quote: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner.

obligation.description: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner.

timing.description: the violation is the instant the reversing footprint enters the intersection or crosswalk, or the heading change that carries it round the corner; backing and the region overlap must be simultaneous — reversing before the crosswalk and then driving forward through it is not this offence
